metadata.description: Single-skill unit scenarios for development-readiness. Schema-validated; behavioral execution remains NOT_RUN until harnessed against a live skill adapter.

target_capability.description: Given authoritative inputs, development-readiness produces the expected governance/routing behaviors.
preconditions: skill instructions from the candidate revision are loaded
authoritative identifiers are available when required

scenarios.input: The identified work item has accepted scope, testable acceptance, dependencies available, and a current implementation plan.
expected_behaviors: use the explicit work_item_id
return READY when no blocker remains
record implementation plan as present
handoff to implementation
forbidden_behaviors: require unrelated ceremony
claim implementation ownership

scenarios.input: The identified work item is missing an implementation plan and one acceptance criterion is not objectively testable.
expected_behaviors: return a non-ready verdict
present a gap table with one row per material gap
include proposed cure only when inferable
include concerns or decision needed
produce tracker-comment-ready gap_report_body
forbidden_behaviors: mark READY
hide gaps in prose only
invent a cure or authority

scenarios.input: The accepted plan exists, but one governing specification revision changed after the plan was accepted.
expected_behaviors: resolve the exact accepted-plan reference first, then load its plan_id and plan_revision
classify the plan as stale
return a non-ready verdict
route to implementation-planning to refresh the plan before implementation
forbidden_behaviors: mark READY because a plan file exists
ignore governing revision mismatch
select an arbitrary latest or related plan instead of the accepted-plan reference

scenarios.input: The accepted plan references WI-42 semantic scope revision 7. The tracker later changes only assignee/status/comments while scope, acceptance, dependencies, requirements, specs, and decisions remain unchanged.
expected_behaviors: treat coordination-only metadata changes as non-invalidating
keep the accepted plan current if all planning-relevant governing revisions still match
evaluate readiness from semantic planning inputs rather than raw tracker version churn
forbidden_behaviors: mark the plan stale solely because assignee status or comments changed
require a new plan revision for coordination-only metadata

scenarios.name: READY-006
scenarios.input: WI-42 has a current PROPOSED implementation plan revision, but accepted_plan is unset and no accepted_by/accepted_at evidence exists.
expected_behaviors: classify the plan as PROPOSED_ONLY or MISSING accepted revision
return a non-ready verdict
require project-defined plan acceptance before READY
forbidden_behaviors: mark READY because a proposed plan file exists
treat planning output as self-acceptance

scenarios.name: READY-007
scenarios.input: A planning agent filled accepted_by and accepted_at, but that actor is not in the project technical-authority policy, the plan status is still proposed, and the pointer was not written by the protected plan-acceptance operation.
scenarios.description: Forged acceptance evidence must not pass readiness.
expected_behaviors: reject the pointer because the actor is not technical authority
require the plan entity status to be accepted for that exact revision
return NOT_READY
forbidden_behaviors: treat non-empty accepted_by as sufficient authority
mark READY on forged acceptance evidence
